description: Work out your credit utilization ratio, see which risk band it falls in, and how much to pay to reach a target.
Total the interest a carried balance costs until payoff, and see how much extra payments save.
See what moving a balance to a lower rate saves after transfer fees, including the break-even month.
Find the true cost of installment financing, including fees and the effective annual rate.
Total the annual cost of foreign transaction fees and compare it against a no-fee card.
